4. **Field Research Approval**: Olivia Grant, a PhD candidate, has submitted a proposal for field research at the Luxor excavation site to study the social hierarchy of New Kingdom workers. She is seeking your approval and has attached her plan and budget.

They propose a video conference to discuss details.

6. **Feedback Request (Spam/Scam)**: An email requesting feedback on a recent purchase, which instructs you to send an email to contact@contact.com with the message "confirmation". This appears to be a phishing or spam attempt.
